subject: Transportation Systems
title: Why Subways Cost So Much
description: Learn Why Subways Cost So Much in one minute.

hook.text: New York's Second Avenue Subway cost $2.5 billion per mile. Some highway miles cost $5 million.

buildup.text: Tunneling, station excavation, utility relocation, and labor all pile up fast underground.

discovery.text: US subway costs are among the world's highest. The same tunnel in Spain or South Korea costs far less.

twist.text: The difference isn't geology—it's regulations, union rules, and overdesigned stations.

climax.text: Cities that streamline approvals and standardize designs build subways at a fraction of the cost.

punchline.text: The most expensive part of a subway is the paperwork.

quiz.question: Why are US subway construction costs among the world's highest?
options: Regulations, labor rules, and overdesigned stations
